tei:div.tei:p: na mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung mar bcas// sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin// dkon mchog gsum sogs bka' yi bden pa'i mthus// bla ma'i sku dgra bstan dang bstan 'dzin smod// khyad par bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya la// snga dgra lag bdar phyi dgra yid la sems// da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs// kha 'jam snying rtsub zhe nas smod pa dang*// do brdo phod btsug bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed// mthu dang nus pa bu lon bzhin du bsnyag /dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa dang*// bar chad byed pa'i bdud dang dam sri sogs// yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs 'di nyid kyi// rnam shes bla tshe srog dang bcas pa rnams// gnam sa gling bzhi gling phran ri rab gseng*// nyi zla'i go bar chos bon srung mas skyabs// gang na gnas kyang gtor ma 'di nyid la// khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ /ske nas chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūm̐// yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐// myos par gyis shig badz+ra ghan+dhe ho// lha dang phyes shig pra we sha ya phaṭa// dbyer med stims shig a we sha ya āḥ /bdag mdun thugs las dzaḥyig dmar nag 'phros// brub bya'i sna bug gshang lam gnyis nas zhugs// snying khar phyin pas zangs lcags 'khor lo gnyis// g.yas g.yon 'khor bas sha khrag bla tshe gtub// rnam shes a yig rgyal ba'i thugs kar 'phos// tshe bsod nṛ yig ljang gu rang la thim// sha khrag bdud rtsir gyur pa srung mas gsol/ shrī dharmā pā la sa pā ri wa ra gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi/ rā ga a s+yes sbyar ba'o/
